verdicts.reason: A is a real reflow into the portrait shape: the text stack is large and readable and the bottle sits beneath it with the circle behind it, so the order runs top to bottom. Its flaws are small: the CTA is tight under the body copy and the bottle crops near the bottom edge. B just keeps the square layout in the middle of the tall canvas, leaving the bottom ~35% empty. Its text and bottle are small for the format, the bottle sits off to the right, and the composition is lopsided.
